summary: Tested the ATC-direct (waypoint delete/undo) feature. Backend: 10/10 pytest pass. Covered skip/restore persistence, 400 for the final fix, 400 for a passed fix and for an ATA-only fix, 404 for a wrong ident/index/flight, 409 on a closed flight, 422 for a bad body (missing skipped, index -1, non-int), 401 without a token, reset clearing skipped, toggle+restore on the user's open flight, and the PDF (build_report_pdf with 2 skipped fixes gives exactly 2 'DCT (skipped)' rows). Frontend: tested on a TEST_ open copy of the closed KEWR-EDDB flight, which has lat/lon. Skipping 62N010W/PEMOS/BEREP/IBAPI turns those rows grey ('removed · direct' with restore buttons). KARLI then shows 'DCT · −35 nm' with Dist 819, Plan/ETO 17:05→17:01, EDDB 18:18→18:13 and Plan FOB 18,701→19,245. Est. landing goes 12,308→12,852 and Progress 0/38→0/34. All of these match my independent Python calculation exactly, and undo restores every value exactly. The map loses the skipped markers. Delete buttons show only on un-passed, non-final rows. Regression on non-skipped rows works: NOW logs the ATA and removes the delete button, the FOB entry gives ΔF -688 and landing 11,625 (replanned 12,313 - 688), and the passed toggle removes the delete button. Next fix and Progress (2/37) ignore skipped fixes. At iPad 1024x1366 the table fits (958px, no overflow). On the user's open flight N806SB (ee9720b3), the UI delete/restore works and 30 delete buttons show (34 - 3 passed - final). But this flight has NO lat/lon on any waypoint (older import), so a direct never recalculates: UMURE showed 'DCT · −0 nm', Dist = 13+27 = 40, and times and fuel were unchanged.

minor.issue: Both accept a skipped fix: I logged ATA 11:00 on a skipped HFD and got 200, leaving skipped=true, passed=true and ata=11:00 at the same time. The UI hides the inputs, so only the API can do this, and the PDF then drops that ATA ('DCT (skipped)'). Suggest 400 when wp.skipped, or un-skip on log.

ui_bugs.issue: colSpan={11} is fixed, but below the lg breakpoint the Wind/GS/Dist columns are hidden (11 visible headers). The skipped row then spans 14 columns, so the table overflows. At 768px: scrollWidth 769 vs clientWidth 718, the header background stops short, and the restore button sits at x=742-786, past the 768 viewport edge (you must scroll horizontally to undo). Fix: colSpan={8} plus 3 empty 'hidden lg:table-cell' tds, or compute colSpan from the breakpoint. At 1024 it is fine.
Shows 'DCT · −0 nm' when the direct saves nothing (straight-line skips, e.g. HFD on the copy) and always on flights without coordinates. Hide the −N part when saved_nm <= 0, or say 'DCT (no saving)'.

integration_issues.flow: Recalc on the user's open flight ee9720b3 (LEIB-EGCC)
integration_issues.issue: All 34 waypoints have lat/lon = null (older import, from before the coordinates were added; _backfill only runs on re-import with the same waypoint count). applyDirects then falls back to direct = orig distance (ratio 1), so ETO, Plan and FOB never change and the label reads −0 nm. Dist becomes the summed distance. The route map is also missing on this flight. The feature works only for flights that have coordinates. Consider backfilling coordinates (re-fetch the OFP by raw_simbrief_id), or tell the user that recalc needs coordinates.

action_items: MEDIUM: Fix the SkippedRow colSpan for widths below lg (768px tablet overflow; the restore button is off-screen).
MEDIUM: Flights without waypoint coordinates (the user's open flight ee9720b3) get no recalc after a direct. Backfill lat/lon, or show a notice instead of 'DCT · −0 nm'.
LOW: Hide '−0 nm' when saved_nm is 0.
LOW: Reject ATA/passed on skipped fixes in /waypoint-log and /waypoint (or clear skipped).
LOW: Removing the FIRST fix (index 0) never recalculates, because applyDirects needs a previous kept fix (prev=null) and the departure airport position is not used.
critical_code_review_comments: flightCalc.applyDirects: the maths checks out (ratio capped at 1, shifts carried forward to later fixes, and ETOs after an ATA use the replanned eta). Index-0 skips are not replanned (no departure anchor).
server.skip_waypoint: the index validation (ge=0, bounds, ident match), final-fix guard, passed/ATA guard and 409 via _editable_flight are all correct. reset_tracker clears skipped.
pdf_report: skipped rows are grey with 'DCT (skipped)'. Plan FOB in the PDF stays the original OFP value, not the replanned one (acceptable for the record, but worth noting).
TOC/TOD pseudo-waypoints can be deleted. This is harmless, but pilots don't get 'directs' to TOC, so consider hiding the bin on them.

success_rate.frontend: ~90% (all core flows pass; 768px colSpan overflow and the no-coordinates recalc gap)

seed_data_creation: I created TEST_iter10_* open copies of closed flight f6604740 (raw_simbrief_id = new id) through iter10_copy_flight.py and deleted them by id. 0 remain. On the user's open flight ee9720b3, EBROX(6) was skipped and restored by both the API and the UI and is now skipped=false. No fix is skipped, and the passed/ATA/FOB on fixes 1, 3 and 4 are unchanged. No reset or close was run on user flights.
